scope: YOLO Step 0/1 only; no teacher/student or identity matching
selection: Calibration30 only tunes rules and thresholds; Development100 chooses among frozen arms once; full official test evaluated once after final freeze
exposure_warning: Calibration and development are historical exposed validation cohorts; full official test is also previously exposed, not a fresh holdout.

success_rule.unmapped_cap: Historical G on the same cohort
success_rule.reference: Best feasible preexisting base/raw/G arm under G unmapped cap

training.start: Existing A300; fresh optimizer identically in both arms
training.schedule: linear warmup from .1*peak, then cosine decay
training.sliced600: same image schedule; two full frames and two fixed 768px crops per batch, alternating slots; all intersecting GT clipped and retained; no pseudo labels
training.checkpoint_selection: final update only; no early selection on development

inference.head: one2many
inference.note: All old/new arms use the same 768 inference resolution; 1024 is training only; native tile pixels unchanged.

tile_policy: Preserve full-frame prefix; filter before merging. Reject artificial-edge cuts. Small/large means predicted native short side <96/≥96. Nonedge other-tile support IoU≥.55 and confidence≥.4 when required below .8; correlated evidence only. Seam containment rejects IoS≥limit before normal IoU .55 dedup.
scoring: Frozen class-agnostic maximum eligible IoU-sum assignment at IoU≥.50; micro recall/precision; U=predictions−localized; both-view endpoint coverage, not identity accuracy. Native short-side size strata. Setup bootstrap 20,000 draws; one seed exploratory.
